
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/23559864" title="发布于 2026-11-05 14:29">
    

    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">java 多线程开发系列之十：带返回值的异步接口（callable/future）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">用过多线程的人肯定都知道，最常用的方式就是通过runnable接口，然后通过Thread类或者线程池来异步跑起来。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">但是这个接口有个很大的缺陷：它其中的抽象方法没有返回值。想要拿到异步的处理结果，只能通过引用一个对象，或者一个全局变量，来查看结果，并且由于无法获知线程是否已经执行完毕，只能不断的去取值判断，很不优雅。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">java5的版本中，为了解决这个问题，提供了两个新接口Callable/future。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">callable源码如下</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@FunctionalInterface
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span> Callable&lt;V&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * Computes a result, or throws an exception if unable to do so.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> computed result
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Exception if unable to compute a result
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     V call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Exception;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">接口很简单，提供了一个call 方法，类似于runnable 中的run方法一样，用来定义异步任务的业务逻辑。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">但注意，它有两个很重要的区别：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）有泛型的返回值</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）接口有异常抛出</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">注意，runnable是不能抛出受检异常的，这相当于为异步任务的结束扩充了途径。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">@FunctionalInterface
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Runnable {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/**</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * When an object implementing interface {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@code</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> Runnable} is used
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * to create a thread, starting the thread causes the object's
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@code</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> run} method to be called in that separately executing
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * thread.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * &lt;p&gt;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * The general contract of the method {</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@code</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> run} is that it may
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * take any action whatsoever.
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     *
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     * </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">@see</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">     java.lang.Thread#run()
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> run();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">接着是 future接口，future的主要作用是获取返回值。它的本质是一个句柄，是拿到返回值的一个"凭证"。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">说到句柄，这个翻译实在是太粗糙、晦涩了。我实在无法理解当时的翻译人员是怎么想的，先不说信达雅，连汉语是母语的人都一脸懵。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这里简单解释下，所谓的句柄就是间接引用。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">句柄的英文是handle，表示 把手、手柄、握把。(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )比如门把手，水杯把手。是持有对象的一个间接引用。表示你可以间接用手（hanle）触及到的东西。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这里我们可以粗糙的理解future就是返回结果的一个“把手”，通过它来间接的控制返回结果。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">来看一下java中的Future接口的源码：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">interface</span> Future&lt;V&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> cancel(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mayInterruptIfRunning);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isCancelled();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> isDone();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>     V get() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException, ExecutionException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>     V get(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">long</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> timeout, TimeUnit unit)
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException, ExecutionException, TimeoutException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;<strong style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">get()</strong><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;"> 方法是获取返回结果，因为是异步等待，并不知任务的具体的返回结果和时间，所以是get方法阻塞式的等待方法。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">它有两个重载，一个是无限制等待，一个是有超时时间的等待。这两个重载方法会抛出多个异常：</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）InterruptedException</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">阻塞方法一般会声明抛出InterruptedException来中断线程，防止无限制等待。（不了解中断线程的同学可以看看我之前的文章&nbsp;<em>线程的中断&nbsp; https://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/p/22869617</em>）</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）ExecutionException</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">call方法本身是支持抛出异常的，当异常抛出后，就可以在future的get方法处，接收到执行异常ExecutionException。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个异常是对call方法抛出的异常进行的封装。我们在获取返回结果时，应该考虑到对这个异常的处理。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（3）TimeoutException</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">超时异常是只，对于设置超时时间等待的get方法，如果等待时间到，则会抛出该异常来终止等待。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（4）CancellationException</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">CancellationException是运行时异常，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )所以没有显示的方法声明时标记。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这个异常表示当前异步任务已经被取消了，无法获取到返回结果。无论是get前任务被取消，还是get过程中任务被取消。get方法都会抛出此异常。</span></p>
<p><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">接下来先说<strong>cancel方法（）</strong></span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">cancel(boolean mayInterruptIfRunning)</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">方法表示要取消异步任务，但是这个取消会考虑到任务的状态。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">传false，表示对于开始运行的异步任务，不会调用线程中断interrupt。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">传true，表示对于开始运行的异步任务，会调用线程中断interrupt。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">注意无论任务是否已经开始启动，只要任务还没有完成，该方法都会将任务状态置为已取消。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">因为任务线程一旦开始，如果被终止的话，可能会有资源泄露，连接未关闭等问题。所以这里一般要谨慎考虑。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">而所谓的取消，并不是调用thread的stop之类的方法来强制取消，也是通过中断线程，来尝试取消。尝试取消一般是通过更改任务状态，调用线程的interrupt来中断。如果都没问题，cancel就会返回true。但是假若任务线程内部并没有中断方法，或相应的中断check，仍然无法处理中断，还会无止尽的。也就是说cancel虽然返回true了，但是其实任务线程还是会无休止的运行下去。</span><br><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">而任务如果已经完成了，或者已经被取消了。修改状态失败，则该方法会返回false。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">然后是<strong>boolean isCancelled()方法</strong>，该方法很简单，用来判断当前任务是否已经被取消了。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">最后是<strong>isDone(),</strong>用来获取异步任务是否已经结束（包括完成或者是取消）。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">Future接口是一个泛型接口，需要和配合使用的Callable的输出泛型保持一致。</span></p>
<p><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1); font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">这两接口常常是配合线程池来使用。我们举个例子：</span>&nbsp;</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Callable;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Executors;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Future;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallableStudy {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutionException, InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>         Callable&lt;String&gt; task1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Callable&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>                 TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> "hi , 很高兴遇见你"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span>         Callable&lt;String&gt; task2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Callable&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>                 TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> "hi , 很高兴再次遇见你"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>         ExecutorService executor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>         Future&lt;String&gt; future1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span>         Future&lt;String&gt; future2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span>         String result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> future1.get();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span>         System.out.println("call1 ,result :"+result + " status :"+ future1.isDone()+","+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">future2.isDone());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>         result =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> future2.get();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span>         System.out.println("call2 ,result :"+result + " status :"+ future1.isDone()+","+<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">future2.isDone());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;<span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;">输出如下</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>call1 ,result :hi , 很高兴遇见你 status :<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
call2 ,result :hi , 很高兴再次遇见你 status :</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span>,<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">call1刚拿到返回值时，call1任务是已完成，call2任务肯定在运行（睡眠中），所以call2此时isDone是false</span></p>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">再来看下cancel的场景</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 1</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">package</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> org.example.webdevelop;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 2</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 3</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Callable;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 4</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.ExecutionException;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 5</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.ExecutorService;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 6</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Executors;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 7</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.Future;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 8</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">import</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)"> 9</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">10</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CallableCancelStudy {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">11</span>     <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span> main(String[] args) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecutionException, InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">12</span>         Callable&lt;String&gt; task1 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Callable&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">13</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">14</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">15</span>                 System.out.println("start call 1"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">16</span>                 TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">17</span>                 System.out.println("end call 1"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">18</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> "hi , 很高兴遇见你"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">19</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">20</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">21</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">22</span>         Callable&lt;String&gt; task2 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Callable&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">23</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">24</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">25</span>                 System.out.println("start call 2"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">26</span>                 TimeUnit.SECONDS.sleep(1L<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">27</span>                 System.out.println("end call 2"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">28</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> "hi , 很高兴再次遇见你"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">29</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">30</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">31</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">32</span>         Callable&lt;String&gt; task3 = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Callable&lt;String&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">() {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">33</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            @Override
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">34</span>             <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> String call() <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">throws</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> InterruptedException {
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">35</span>                 System.out.println("start call 3"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">36</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">37</span>                 System.out.println("end call 3"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">38</span>                 <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> "hi , 很高兴再次遇见你"<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">39</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">40</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        };
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">41</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">42</span>         ExecutorService executor =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Executors.newSingleThreadExecutor();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">43</span>         Future&lt;String&gt; future3 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task3);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">44</span>         Future&lt;String&gt; future1 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task1);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">45</span>         Future&lt;String&gt; future2 =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> executor.submit(task2);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">46</span>         TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.sleep(500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">47</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        future3.get();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">48</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> cancelOpt1 = future1.cancel(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">49</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> cancelOpt2 = future2.cancel(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">50</span>         <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">boolean</span> cancelOpt3 = future3.cancel(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">51</span> 
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">52</span>         System.out.println("call's cancel result :" + cancelOpt1 + "," + cancelOpt2 + "," +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> cancelOpt3);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">53</span>         System.out.println("call's done status :" + future1.isDone() + "," + future2.isDone() + "," +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> future3.isDone());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">54</span>         System.out.println("call1 ,cancel status :" + future1.isCancelled() + "," + future2.isCancelled() +
<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">55</span>                 "," +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> future3.isCancelled());
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">56</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    }
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 128, 1)">57</span> }</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">输出如下：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>start call 3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
end call </span>3<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong>
start call 1</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"><strong>
call's cancel result :true,true,false</strong></span>
<strong><span style="color: rgba(51, 153, 102, 1)">call's done status :true,true,true</span></strong>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">call1 ,cancel status :true,true,false
<strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">end call 1</span></strong></span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">开始执行取消操作时，call1，运行中，call2 还未开始启动（因为线程池只有1个线程），call3 已经任务执行完成</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">我们逐一分析输出日志，(防盗连接：本文首发自http://www.cnblogs.com/jilodream/ )我们可以得到三个信息：</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（1）此时的三个取消动作的结果为（红色日志），成功，成功，失败。即对已经运行完成的任务是尝试取消失败的。</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（2）无论取消是否成功，取消结束后，完成状态isDone就都为true了（绿色日志）。这是由于任务运行完成的，虽然标记失败，但是它本来就是isDone=true的效果。任务未完成的（执行中+未开始），都会因为被标记为取消，而将完成状态isDone 标记为true</span><br><span style="font-family: &quot;Microsoft YaHei&quot;; font-size: 14px">（3）任务1虽然已经被取消成功了（蓝色日志），任务1的取消状态也已改变，但是由于没有收到中断信号interrupt，因此还是会一直运行直到结束。</span></p>

</div>
